summary: New Zealand's Black Foils carry no title sponsor; Rodd & Gunn, ITM and AGP are official partners and SkyCity Auckland and Zhik official suppliers. Live Ocean, a marine-conservation foundation, is the team's charitable 'purpose partner', not a paying sponsor.
